entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I... I think I need to return something? I bought some cycling shoes, and I'm just so confused about everything.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I get your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?
Yes, my email is confused.cyclist@email.com. It's about the shoes I ordered.

Thank you. I see your order for the VeloFit RoadPro cycling shoes, delivered on January 10th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

I guess it's about the fit? I'm not really sure. I attached the cleats and went for just one short ride, but they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. They just don't feel right at all. The website was a bit overwhelming. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I'm here to help. I'm sorry to hear they were so uncomfortable; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. It sounds like you'd like to return them for a full refund. Is that correct?
Yes, please. A refund would be wonderful. Is that even possible since I wore them outside?

Let me quickly verify the return policy for this item. One moment... Okay, yes. Standard items like these cycling shoes are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only on day six, you are unfortunately outside that timeframe.
Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them.

Not at all. I've just initiated the return for you. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop them off. Once we receive them back at our warehouse, we'll process your refund.
Wow, thank you so much, Diana. You've made this so simple.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
